title: Stream transcript (valid): minimal SESSION_INIT
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with a single SESSION_INIT entry. Validates that the session layer activates a session when a valid SESSION_INIT is received on a NO_INDEX stream with a nonzero Stream ID. Does not require live TCP/QUIC transport.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
The same bytes are valid in stream-session context; a static-archive profile would reject them.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
